sectors.trend: Mixed: gold and rare earths exploration at highs (Great Southern, Barkly NT, Kaiser, Lindian), but iron ore under pressure. Uranium exploration (Infini) gaining momentum.
sectors.implications: Gold miners (GOLD.AX, NVA.AX) and rare earths (LRE.AX, GRC.AX) benefit from safe-haven flows and supply-chain diversification. Iron ore names (BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX) face margin pressure. Uranium (NCI.AX, SU32.AX) sees renewed interest.

sectors.trend: Oil prices spike on Iran/Middle East tensions and Hormuz control uncertainty. Oil giant retreats from clean energy, signalling investor pressure limits. Solar crosses economic tipping point.
sectors.implications: Energy majors (WDS.AX, WLE.AX, XOM) benefit from oil spike. Renewables (SOL.AX, LRN.AX) gain from solar cost parity. LNG (GAS.AX) supported by global energy import bill surge.

sectors.trend: Rising rate expectations support NIM but property credit stress (Bathla collapse, investor credit crash) raises NPL concerns. Macquarie $700M audit bid signals M&A activity.
sectors.implications: Banks (CBA.AX, NAB.AX, ANZ.AX, WBC.AX) benefit from higher rates but face property exposure risk. Macquarie (MQG.AX) audit bid is a positive catalyst. Superannuation law reform ($411M teen cost) may drive policy debate.

sectors.trend: GLP-1 drug demand surges via telehealth; 'dupe' brands and EV uptake accelerate. Major fruit grower lays off ~1,000 workers. Casino billionaire clashes with regulators.
sectors.implications: CSL.AX and healthcare names benefit from GLP-1 trend. Consumer staples (WES.AX, WOL.AX) see mixed signals. FMG.AX/fruit sector faces labour cost pressure. Star Entertainment (STAR.AX) in distress.

sectors.trend: Home values decline sharply; auction sentiment deteriorates; property investor credit crashes post-budget tax changes. Postal Realty Trust targets record acquisitions.
sectors.implications: Property REITs (PGY.AX, DGP.AX, VMC.AX) face headwinds from falling values and tighter credit. Industrial/infrastructure REITs (PGY.AX) more resilient. Bathla collapse signals broader property stress.

sectors.trend: AI cloud battle intensifies (Oracle vs Microsoft); SpaceX $100B Louisiana buildout; solar economic tipping point; automation reducing immigration need.
sectors.implications: ASX tech exposure limited but CSL.AX (biotech) and data centre REITs benefit. Solar/renewables capex supports construction (WBC.AX, CGW.AX). Automation theme supports productivity narrative.

Consumer shift: GLP-1 drugs, EV adoption, dupe brands reshaping spending patterns
Corporate distress: Star Entertainment and Bathla signal vulnerability in leveraged sectors

market_outlook.short_term: ASX likely to remain under pressure from rising rate expectations, property stress, and geopolitical oil volatility. Gold and energy outperform; property and iron ore lag. RBA policy uncertainty is the dominant swing factor. Expect ^AXJO to trade in a narrow, risk-off range.
market_outlook.long_term: Critical minerals (gold, rare earths, uranium) offer structural upside. GLP-1 and EV adoption drive consumer/healthcare rotation. Property correction may create value entry points in 6–12 months. Political uncertainty from Labor by-election loss adds policy risk. Solar cost parity and AI infrastructure capex support long-term growth themes.
